in_sanskrit.name: Shariraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Body
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shariraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shariraj is derived from Sanskrit words 'Sharira' meaning body and 'Raj' meaning ruler or king. It signifies the one who rules over the body, representing the divine power that maintains and nourishes the physical form.
